reasons: Section 12.4 binds Customer with a 24-month post-term, worldwide, undefined-scope non-compete ('any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory'), which is explicit walk-away territory under NONCOMPETE and fails the fallback on duration, scope, and carve-outs.

Full deletion of p0046 is the smallest edit that reaches the preferred position, and it is consistent with Section 12.3 which already states Customer has made no non-compete or exclusivity commitment (so deletion creates no gap).
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, cites the playbook position, notes the internal contradiction with 12.3, and offers the narrowed fallback as invited by the redline guidance.
Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.
